meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装好后,AI 助手多了一个 Emacs 入口:可在 Emacs 里打开聊天窗口提问,也可把 org 文件的段落/选区发过去,回答会作为子标题插入原文。通过本地 HTTP 通信,不依赖外部服务。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中用配置的快捷键(如 C-c n c)打开聊天缓冲区并发送消息,或对 org 内容调用 nanoclaw-org-send 时触发;需先在 .env 里设置 EMACS_ENABLED=true。

say.text: 这段代码为什么会报错?
say.note: 在聊天缓冲区按下发送即可收到回答。

say.text: 审查我选中的这段代码,指出问题。
say.note: 需配合 nanoclaw-org-send 发送选区。

say.text: 把当前子树总结成三条行动项。
say.note: 通过 org 发送,答案以子标题插入。

howto.what_en: After installation, the AI assistant gains an Emacs entry point: you can open a chat buffer to ask questions, or send an org subtree/region and get the reply inserted as a child heading. It uses local HTTP; no external service required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the chat buffer with a configured keybinding (e.g. C-c n c) and send a message, or call nanoclaw-org-send on an org subtree/region. Requires EMACS_ENABLED=true in .env.

say_en.text: Why does this code raise an error?
say_en.note: Send it in the chat buffer to get an answer.

say_en.text: Review this selected region for issues.
say_en.note: Use with nanoclaw-org-send on the selection.

say_en.text: Summarize the current subtree into three action items.
say_en.note: Sent via org; the reply lands as a child heading.
